svg.text: STAGE 514 · TOPIC 154 · P1021 🎉–P1022 🎉 · SVG 158 · 156th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 1,030th GUARDRAIL, 1,040th PROBE & 850th LIVE POC MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 5450 / RFC 3550 Transmission Time Offset (toffset) Jitter-Buffer & RTCP J Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 5450 toffset Path (+349s Bug & NetEQ Bloat)
1. Missing 24-Bit Sign Extension (+349.5s Playout Freeze)
toffset = 0xFFFFD0 (-1ms) read as uint32 +16,777,168 ticks!
• At 48kHz Opus, +16.77M ticks = +349.5 seconds into the future
• Freezes NetEQ playout timeline or triggers buffer overflow
2. Extreme ±2000ms toffset Spikes Bloating NetEQ Delay
toffset = +96,000 ticks (+2000ms) -> NetEQ target = 850ms!
• 24-bit signed field legally spans ±174.76s without clamping
• Turns sub-second AI Voice Agent into a sluggish 2-second lag bot
3. RFC 5450 §4 RTCP Interarrival Jitter (J) Inflation
Alternating toffset (0ms, +1000ms) -> RTCP J = 680ms (50x!)
• Poisons outbound RTCP Receiver Report (RR) jitter metrics
• Tricks sender congestion controller into throttling Opus bitrate
✅ Deterministic RFC 5450 Guardrails (P1021 🎉 + P1022 🎉)
P1021 🎉 (1,030th Guardrail!): 24-Bit Sign & [20, 200]ms Window
action: "zero_outlier_toffset_and_clamp_offset_window_ms"
• Enforces 24-bit arithmetic sign extension: (raw24 << 8) >> 8
• clampedToffsetOutlierPackets = 0 (zeroes out-of-window spikes)
• clampedMaxAllowedToffsetMagnitudeMs in [20, 200]ms
Policy: P1021-WEBRTC-RFC5450-TOFFSET-SIGNED-24BIT-BOUNDS-AND-NEGATIVE-OFFSET-GUARD
P1022 🎉 (1,040th Probe & 850th POC!): RTCP J & [40, 160]ms NetEQ
action: "fallback_raw_rtp_timestamp_jitter_and_cap_neteq_delay_ms"
• Falls back to raw RTP timestamp when toffset inflates RTCP J
• clampedPoisonedRtcpJitterReportBlocks = 0 (clean RTCP RR telemetry)
• clampedNeteqTargetPlayoutDelayCeilingMs in [40, 160]ms
Policy: P1022-WEBRTC-RFC5450-RTCP-INTERARRIVAL-JITTER-CONSISTENCY-AND-NETEQ-TARGET-GUARD
PROVENANCE, TIMING DISCLOSURE & STAGE 514 BENCHMARK SCORECARD (517 DIMENSIONS · 1,031 GUARDRAILS 🎉 · 1,040 PROBES 🎉 · 956 TESTS)
Timing Disclosure: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established
